10 REM SL1500 CE-161 &3E00
20 L=&3E00:S=&3F00
30 A=PEEK &7863:IF A<>0 PRINT "CE-161 NEEDED":BEEP 3:END
40 P=2:INPUT "RX PORT (DEFAULT PB2) ";P
50 M=0:IF P=0 LET M=1
60 IF P=2 LET M=4
70 IF M=0 BEEP 1:GOTO 40
80 CLS:WAIT 0:PRINT "INSTALLING..."
90 RESTORE 1000:C=0
100 FOR I=0 TO 194:READ V:POKE L+I,V:C=C+V
102 Q=PEEK (L+I):IF Q<>V GOTO 300
104 NEXT I
105 FOR I=0 TO 120:READ V:POKE S+I,V:C=C+V
107 Q=PEEK (S+I):IF Q<>V GOTO 300
108 NEXT I
110 READ V:IF V<>C PRINT "DATA ERROR":BEEP 3:END
120 POKE L+16,255-M
130 POKE L+25,M:POKE L+41,M:POKE L+61,M:POKE L+74,M
135 P$="PB2":IF M=1 LET P$="PB0"
140 CLS:WAIT 100:PRINT "SL1500 READY 4800 ";P$
150 PRINT "LOAD CALL &3E00 NEW 1ST"
160 PRINT "SAVE CALL &3F00"
165 PRINT "KEEP MEM ABOVE 6700"
170 WAIT 0:END
300 CLS:WAIT 0:PRINT "WRITE PROTECT ON?":BEEP 3:END
